notes.content: An unsigned page of a typed letter addressed to Grothendieck, dated Voorschoten, May 16 1967, with the address Palestrinalaan 11. Paragraph 1 asks whether the new setup is best understood by the behaviour of a covering over the special coverings s(M), against the background of Abhyankar's lemma. Paragraph 2 questions uniqueness of the extra structure on a Galois covering, the commutation of two group actions, and the fully faithful geometric-realization assertion. Paragraph 3 asks about the couples in example 3a and proposes a divisibility condition in place of an inequality. These claims are reported as the letter's questions and assertions, not independently established. No signature appears on this page.
